name: skill_update
description: Context-aware skill updater. Tracks how the user interacts with each skill (what they asked, what the skill returned, whether it was correct), records preference signals (accept/reject/correct) plus free-form context, and applies those preferences to skill files. Safely edits manifest.json (description, triggers, aliases, version, category, surface, requires, parameters), bumps semantic versions, keeps a per-skill change history for rollback, and records interaction context so the agent can tune skills over time. Nothing is rewritten blindly: Python skill.py changes are flagged for manual review or done as safe targeted string replacements; every write is versioned and revertible. Writes to disk, so install/update needs authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule.

operation.description: One of: sources | list | inspect | record_pref | preferences | update_manifest | bump_version | apply_prefs | rollback | history. Defaults to sources.

skill.description: The skill name to update or inspect (e.g. anatomy, brainstorming). Required for most operations.

context.description: Interaction context: what the user asked, what the skill returned, and whether it was correct/acceptable (record_pref operation).

signal.description: Preference signal: accept | reject | correct (record_pref operation).

field.description: The manifest field to update (update_manifest operation): description | triggers | aliases | version | category | surface | requires | parameters.

value.description: The new value for the field (update_manifest operation). For triggers/aliases/parameters pass JSON.

bump.description: Semver bump level: patch | minor | major (bump_version operation). Defaults to patch.

to_version.description: Target version to roll back to (rollback operation).

authorized.description: Must be true for any operation that writes skill files (update_manifest, bump_version, apply_prefs, rollback, record_pref).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually write skill files.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Writes into features/<skill>/ and features/skill_update/{history,preferences,context}/. Every write is versioned and revertible via rollback. Requires authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule.
